hard_constraints: Produce optimized.stl as one watertight, winding-consistent, connected positive-volume solid.
Keep the solid inside the stated coordinate envelope and above the minimum useful spans.
Keep material volume between 14500 and 54000 mm^3.
Provide the stated z=0 base contact region and minimum 4 mm base thickness.
Use only fins and externally open airflow gaps meeting the stated thickness, spacing, direction, run, height, count, and base-connectivity thresholds.
Use only the supplied task inputs; do not use evaluator-generated artifacts or evaluator implementation files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
A non-watertight, inverted, disconnected, internally enclosed, or non-manifold shell.
Coordinate-envelope, bounding-span, volume, base-contact, base-thickness, fin, or airflow-gap violation.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.
metric: (single connected exterior-shell area minus z=0 base contact area) / material volume; higher is better after all hard constraints pass
metric_scope: Geometry-only surface-density proxy; no thermal or CFD performance is claimed.
objective: Maximize externally exposed geometric surface area per material volume for a constrained straight-fin heat sink.
